annotations.title: Book a tour (returns a payment link)

description: Creates a tour booking pending payment and returns its reference and a secure payment page on phiphiparadise.travel. Requires traveller_confirmed: true, set once the traveller has approved the tour, date, party, total and payment. Payment is online: 'full' (default) or 'deposit' when the tour offers it (shared tours: the rest is paid in cash to the tour operator on the day; private tours: the rest is paid in cash on the day). Some tours are paid in full only. The booking is secured only when the traveller pays on that page.

confirm_duplicate.description: Only true if the traveller explicitly wants a SECOND identical booking after an ALREADY BOOKED answer.

hotel.description: Hotel name, needed for tours with hotel pickup (Phuket, Krabi).

language.description: Traveller language code (en, fr, de, es, zh...). Sets the emails and the payment page language.

option.description: Exact option label when the tour has several priced options.

traveller_confirmed.description: true once the traveller has approved the restated product, date, party, total and payment.

traveller_email.description: Email: receives the confirmation and e-ticket after payment.

traveller_name.description: Full name of the lead traveller.

traveller_phone.description: WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. +33612345678). Strongly recommended: the local team uses it on the day.
